title: 3-n-Propionyl Zaluzanin C from Saussurea involucrata alleviates inflammation and oxidative stress: potential involvement of the NRF2 signaling pathway.
authors: Liang, Lianting; Zhang, Bodou; Liu, Juntao; Liu, Yali; Zhu, Yilin; Han, Jing; Feng, Wenjing; Liang, Zhenhua; Zhang, Yu; Kang, Wenyi
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物NPZC通过NRF2信号通路抗炎抗氧化，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Inflammation and oxidative stress are core pathological processes in the development of numerous chronic diseases, mutually reinforcing each other to create a vicious cycle. Consequently, identifying natural compounds capable of concurrently mitigating both processes, along with the elucidation of their mechanisms, is crucial for therapeutic development. OBJECTIVE: This study aims to investigate the anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, along with their molecular mechanisms, of the novel sesquiterpene lactone compound 3-n-Propionyl Zaluzanin C (NPZC), isolated from Saussurea involucrata. STUDY DESIGN: Utilizing an integrated approach of network pharmacology, cellular assays, molecular docking, and zebrafish models, this study systematically evaluated the bioactivities of NPZC and elucidated its underlying mechanisms of action. METHODS: Network pharmacology was utilized to screen potential targets and pathways. The effects of NPZC were then interrogated in cellular models of LPS-induced inflammation (RAW264.7) and H(2)O(2)-induced oxidative stress (HepG2), quantifying inflammatory mediators, ROS levels, antioxidant enzyme activity, and related protein expression. The interaction between NPZC and key targets was validated by molecular docking and cellular thermal shift assays (CETSA). Finally, the protective efficacy of NPZC was confirmed in a zebrafish model, ameliorating both AAPH-induced oxidative damage and LPS-triggered inflammatory phenotypes. RESULTS: NPZC effectively suppressed the release of LPS-induced inflammatory mediators (TNF-alpha, IL-6, NO and COX-2), scavenged H(2)O(2)-induced ROS, and enhanced the activity of antioxidant enzymes (CAT, SOD and GSH). Mechanistic studies indicate that NPZC does not directly inhibit the NF-kappaB pathway. Instead, it activates the NRF2 signaling pathway, promoting NRF2 nuclear translocation and upregulating downstream antioxidant genes (HO-1 and NQO1). Consequently, NPZC enhances cellular antioxidant capacity and indirectly suppresses NF-kappaB-mediated inflammation. The direct binding of NPZC to both NRF2 and KEAP1 was confirmed by molecular docking and CETSA. These actions were corroborated in vivo, where NPZC alleviated oxidative damage and inflammatory phenotypes in zebrafish, concomitant with the upregulation of NRF2 pathway. CONCLUSION: NPZC disrupts the vicious cycle of inflammation and oxidative stress by activating the NRF2 signaling pathway, thereby enhancing cellular antioxidant defenses and indirectly suppressing the NF-kappaB pathway. This study not only elucidates the modern scientific basis for the traditional medicinal effects of S.involucrata but also provides novel candidate compounds and theoretical foundations for developing natural anti-inflammatory and antioxidant drugs targeting NRF2. Future studies would clarify the relationship between the NPZC and NRF2 using point mutation analysis and surface plasmon resonance. Mechanistic validation will be further enhanced through multi-omics approaches, with confirmed conversion potential subsequently validated in mammalian models.
abstract_zh: 背景：炎症与氧化应激是众多慢性疾病发生发展中的核心病理过程，二者相互促进，形成恶性循环。因此，识别能够同时缓解这两个过程的天然化合物，并阐明其作用机制，对于治疗开发至关重要。目的：本研究旨在探讨从新疆雪莲（Saussurea involucrata）中分离的新型倍半萜内酯化合物3-n-丙酰基Zaluzanin C（NPZC）的抗炎和抗氧化作用及其分子机制。研究设计：本研究采用网络药理学、细胞实验、分子对接和斑马鱼模型的综合方法，系统评估了NPZC的生物活性，并阐明其潜在的作用机制。方法：利用网络药理学筛选潜在靶点和通路。随后，在LPS诱导的炎症（RAW264.7）和H(2)O(2)诱导的氧化应激（HepG2）细胞模型中检测NPZC的作用，量化炎症介质、ROS水平、抗氧化酶活性和相关蛋白表达。通过分子对接和细胞热位移分析（CETSA）验证NPZC与关键靶点的相互作用。最后，在斑马鱼模型中确认NPZC的保护功效，改善AAPH诱导的氧化损伤和LPS触发的炎症表型。结果：NPZC有效抑制LPS诱导的炎症介质（TNF-α、IL-6、NO和COX-2）的释放，清除H(2)O(2)诱导的ROS，并增强抗氧化酶（CAT、SOD和GSH）的活性。机制研究表明，NPZC不直接抑制NF-κB通路，而是激活NRF2信号通路，促进NRF2核转位并上调下游抗氧化基因（HO-1和NQO1）。因此，NPZC增强细胞抗氧化能力，并间接抑制NF-κB介导的炎症。分子对接和CETSA证实了NPZC与NRF2和KEAP1的直接结合。这些作用在体内得到验证，NPZC减轻了斑马鱼的氧化损伤和炎症表型，同时伴随NRF2通路的上调。结论：NPZC通过激活NRF2信号通路，增强细胞抗氧化防御并间接抑制NF-κB通路，从而打破炎症和氧化应激的恶性循环。本研究不仅阐明了新疆雪莲传统药用功效的现代科学基础，也为开发靶向NRF2的天然抗炎和抗氧化药物提供了新的候选化合物和理论基础。未来研究将通过点突变分析和表面等离子体共振技术明确NPZC与NRF2之间的关系，并通过多组学方法进一步增强机制验证，随后在哺乳动物模型中确认其转化潜力。
